recommend.rationale: Verdict: upheld (rejected at triage). recommendAdmission: false. ripgrep 15.1.0 is regex text search. It makes no symbol, call-graph or caller-resolution claim, so it cannot substitute for trailhq/graft caller lookup. The match ranks graft first at only 0.0878, and that lexical score comes from the lead's own comparator wording (graft, symbol, where, find), not from any capability overlap. Dedupe found no prior lead. No experiment is warranted.
